prompt: Animate THIS EXACT approved creature, preserving its silhouette, anatomy, carved ivory mask, braided wood limbs, turquoise cloth with gold trim, amber eye and green leaves. Create a PRODUCTION TRANSPARENT sprite sheet: exactly FOUR equal columns and SEVEN equal rows = 28 frames. Tall 4:7 canvas. No text, labels, grid, borders, shadows outside the creature, projectiles, particles, or baked flash. Fixed side camera facing RIGHT. SAME PHYSICAL SCALE in every cell. Generous empty gutters, nothing touches cell boundaries. Fixed horizontal body anchor; a common floor at 85% of every cell (for flyer common flight center). Same detailed pixel clusters as reference; NOT smooth illustration and NOT coarse oversized blocks. Each row is four consecutive DISTINCT articulated poses, not a translated or resized duplicate. Rows in strict order: 1 idle breathing loop, 2 movement loop, 3 attack anticipation neutral-to-ready, 4 attack action, 5 recovery back to idle, 6 hurt recoil returning balance, 7 death buckle/fall to final inert corpse. No disappearance. Preserve character's identity in every frame. Rooted hooded ivory bird-mask rifle sentry on two broad stone-root feet. Keep the SINGLE long horizontal wooden cannon pointing right and clearly attached to shoulder. Idle cloth breathe. Move means FOUR stance-adjustment poses lifting and replanting one root foot, not relocation. Anticipation shoulders brace, barrel rises slightly, torso leans forward. Attack cannon snaps backward under recoil then returns across four poses, NO projectile or muzzle flash. Recovery barrel settles and cloth overshoots. Hurt mask recoils, cloth fans backward. Death knees break stance, barrel drops, body folds sideways into settled heap with mask and rifle visible.
